plugin.note: Cave crawlers have 22 hitpoints and a max hit of 3, and are poisonous (poison level 8). Any melee weapon dispatches them quickly; bring an antipoison. The Fremennik Slayer Dungeon needs no light source.

requirements: 10 Slayer is required for cave crawler assignments.
An antipoison is recommended, as cave crawlers inflict poison.
A light source and rope are required only if fighting them in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
mechanics: Cave crawlers have 22 hitpoints and a max hit of 3.
They attack with melee (stab) and are poisonous (poison level 8).
They have no elemental weakness in their standard form.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Kill cave crawlers with any melee weapon in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; they have 22 HP and a max hit of 3.
steps: Travel to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon cave crawler area (no light source needed).
Attack cave crawlers with any melee weapon until the task is complete; sip antipoison as needed.

methods.label: Ranged safespot
methods.summary: Safespot cave crawlers with Ranged to avoid melee damage and poison entirely.
requiredOrKeyItems: A crossbow or bow with ammunition
steps: Position behind a rock or gap so the cave crawler cannot reach you in melee.
Attack with Ranged until the task is complete.
